morning_deliveries.title: Morning Deliveries
morning_deliveries.desc: Maren has three parcels that need delivering before noon. The usual route, the usual faces.

objectives.text: Report to Maren at the Post House
Deliver the parcel to the Windsong Tavern
Deliver Tessa's parcel to Skywatch Point
Deliver the seed parcel to the Cloud Edge
Return to Maren at the Post House

hidden_workshop.title: The Hidden Workshop
hidden_workshop.desc: The workshop on Old Cartographer's Bluff officially belongs to Kieran now. Elias left more questions than answers.

objectives.text: Return to the workshop on Old Cartographer's Bluff

into_the_clouds.title: Into the Clouds
into_the_clouds.desc: 'Look where the wind refuses to go.' The compass points past the edge of the Bluff, along a current no map has ever shown.

objectives.text: Take the glider to the edge of the Bluff
Find where the wind refuses to go

elias_was_here.title: Elias Was Here
elias_was_here.desc: Elias scribbled notes everywhere he went. Some of them must still be around Brindle Isle.

objectives.text: Find Elias's notes around Brindle Isle
